text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each point is one of the 11 quantiles each forecast gives. On the dashed line the forecast is perfectly calibrated: a quantile promised to be exceeded 5% of the time was exceeded 5% of the time. Above the line, the quantile sits too high; below it, too low. 292 daily forecast runs from July 2025 to June 2026, each forecasting up to 14 days ahead. Band: 95% interval from resampling whole months.'
